mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_telemetry (vehicle_id, driver_id, sampled_at, latitude, longitude, speed_kmh, received_at, coordinate_system) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{driverId}, #{sampledAt}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{speedKmh,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{receivedAt}, 'GCJ-02') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sampled_at = vehicle_telemetry.sampled_at
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ingest_id),0) FROM vehicle_telemetry WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId}
mapper.sql: t.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND t.driver_id=b.driver_id AND t.sampled_at=( SELECT MAX(previous.sampled_at) FROM vehicle_telemetry previous WHERE previous.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND previous.driver_id=b.driver_id )
mapper.select: SELECT b.vehicle_id, b.driver_id, b.driver_count, t.sampled_at, t.latitude, t.longitude, t.speed_kmh, t.received_at, c.id AS movement_check_id, c.stopped_at, c.first_sampled_at, c.second_sampled_at, c.detected_at, t.coordinate_system FROM current_binding b LEFT JOIN vehicle_telemetry t ON LEFT JOIN fleet f ON f.id=b.fleet_id AND f.enabled=0 LEFT JOIN vehicle_stopped_motion_state m ON m.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND m.fleet_id=f.id AND m.driver_id=b.driver_id AND m.stopped_at=f.stopped_at LEFT JOIN vehicle_stopped_motion_check c ON c.id=m.check_id

SELECT b.vehicle_id, b.driver_id, task.id AS task_id FROM current_binding b JOIN transport_task task ON task.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND task.driver_id=b.driver_id AND task.fleet_id=b.fleet_id AND task.status='RUNNING' AND task.departed_at IS NOT NULL JOIN vehicle_telemetry t ON WHERE t.sampled_at < #{cutoff} AND t.sampled_at >= TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, '1970-01-01 08:00:00', task.departed_at) DIV 1000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vehicle_task_offline_notice n WHERE n.task_id=task.id AND n.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND n.driver_id=b.driver_id AND n.last_sampled_at=t.sampled_at)
SELECT stopped_at FROM fleet WHERE id=#{fleetId} AND enabled=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_stopped_motion_state(vehicle_id,fleet_id,driver_id,stopped_at,last_sampled_at,above_threshold,check_id) VALUES (#{vehicleId},#{fleetId},#{driverId},#{stoppedAt},#{lastSampledAt},#{aboveThreshold},#{checkId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fleet_id=#{fleetId},driver_id=#{driverId},stopped_at=#{stoppedAt}, last_sampled_at=#{lastSampledAt},above_threshold=#{aboveThreshold},check_id=#{checkId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
